description: Thai venues within a straight-line radius of a UK postcode. Use when the user gives a postcode or a place rather than a city name. Returns venues with great-circle distance in miles, rating and address; road distance will always be longer than the figure returned. No delivery, booking or opening-hours data.

min_rating.description: Minimum FHRS rating, 0-5. Scottish venues are excluded when this is set.

name: find_nearby
title: Find venues near a postcode
